clips.title: The story
paras: Runners carry word through Ashenvale as the Warsong Clan faces growing pressure along the border. Their report warns commanders of increasingly bold naga attacks on Horde outposts.

Warsong scouts and runners watch the fighting across Ashenvale and keep supply lines open. They face night elf sentinels and the dangers of the forest, so commanders need word from the frontier quickly. Couriers carry dispatches to remote garrisons and commanders such as Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart.

Horde defenders expect to face night elves among the trees, but outpost sentries report bolder attacks by naga. The serpentine invaders strike from waterways and ancient ruins, testing the barricades and drawing defenders away from forest and border patrols. The dispatch to the Mor'shan Rampart warns of these coordinated attacks from the water.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.
You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, friend. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.
But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
